## Design

### 2026-10-06 — Right now, I worked on my Strabie PCB board. I was having trouble at first because I didn't add the symbol and footprint libraries:

**10h**

Right now, I worked on my Strabie PCB board. I was having trouble at first because I didn't add the symbol and footprint libraries:
Symbol library:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xberrermAib68lxqkhHr2gaXWXyvxHtR/91d791a30411b51793623f1ce45b151bfc7ea12a397cf7e9bc6dc5c6e3d5644a.png)

Footprint Library:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xberrermAib68lxqkhHr2gaXWXyvxHtR/5346d6759dea0a4554f27511bd324507708568acb7fb0f967583390c4df35a29.png)

After I added the libraries I needed to understand the platform (this was my first time using KiCad).

After about two hours, I finished my schematic for Starbie:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xberrermAib68lxqkhHr2gaXWXyvxHtR/d41b438d05f21b0779aa8853983a7e91f01fb598a40d72c63880ae9f3100abe2.png)

After that, I started my PCB design. Instead of making the star like the guide showed, I decided to make a rectangular PCB design because I felt that would be easier. Oh how wrong I was.

I started the wiring process and quickly realized that placement matters. I tried for 3-4 hours
because of how frustrating the process was- the wires kept blocking other wires and I thought it was impossible. In one last attempt I changed the positioning so the wires were as short as possible and finally, all of my components were connected:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xberrermAib68lxqkhHr2gaXWXyvxHtR/670855285a9f877dba00b6c7c413947af5787ee212be0a35d80708bee152e3a9.png)

Then, I downloaded my bom.csv from KiCad:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xberrermAib68lxqkhHr2gaXWXyvxHtR/68d1a286baa75604a7936ef4ea88a9e6d8d054cee312a6e8a8318ad899396f1e.png)

I also uploaded all of the necessary files to my github repo.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xberrermAib68lxqkhHr2gaXWXyvxHtR/856f24480d965bfe9e4a51976a0d107565105c32e59bca24dae9653d4cf4b31e.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xberrermAib68lxqkhHr2gaXWXyvxHtR/fd8fb54b975b9055c004c57bd38a84d203afb53a8fcdc81e41c089e026b44ea0.png)

I then downloaded the arduino ide:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xberrermAib68lxqkhHr2gaXWXyvxHtR/50382ca7e242e69fea7c80c76f926cf252881aa70387bb4c899924ea6954ab11.png)
